description: Analyst flow: given a mocked schema + a mocked run_analysis result, the Data Analyst answers a vendor-spend question with the computed number, calls run_analysis at least once, stays within the tool budget, and never calls any write tool or leaks internal IDs.

input.user_message: Which vendor cost us the most this year?

describe_mirror_schema.return: {"ok": true, "tables": {"helixis_bills": ["buildium_id bigint", "vendor_id bigint", "total_amount numeric", "bill_date date", "is_paid boolean"], "helixis_vendors": ["buildium_id bigint", "name text"]}}

run_analysis.return: {"ok": true, "columns": ["vendor", "total_spend"], "rows": [{"vendor": "Apex Plumbing", "total_spend": 18450.0}, {"vendor": "Brightline HVAC", "total_spend": 12210.0}, {"vendor": "Cedar Landscaping", "total_spend": 4310.0}], "row_count": 3, "truncated": false, "executed_sql": "SELECT v.name AS vendor, SUM(b.total_amount) AS total_spend FROM helixis_bills b JOIN helixis_vendors v ON v.buildium_id = b.vendor_id GROUP BY v.name ORDER BY total_spend DESC"}
